method: Coordinates are copied from the cited primary source. U.S. Census Bureau address geocodes are calculated along TIGER address ranges, as its API documentation states; they are approximate address points, not building footprints or verified entrances. NPS event coordinates identify the named event location, not a general property centroid. No point is inferred from a map image or interpolated between other places.

places.title: Findlay Market / Corporation office address

source.title: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder — 132 W Elder Street, Public_AR_Current

places.precision: Approximate TIGER address-range coordinate for the Corporation for Findlay Market's listed physical address, 132 W Elder Street. This is on the market block; it is not a surveyed market footprint or the 1801 Race Street visitor-address point. Address context: https://www.findlaymarket.org/contact.

places.title: Cincinnati Music Hall

source.title: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder — 1241 Elm Street, Public_AR_Current

places.precision: Approximate TIGER address-range point for the venue's official address, 1241 Elm Street; not the building footprint or a surveyed entrance. Cincinnati Arts confirms the address and identifies an Elm Street wheelchair-accessible entrance: https://www.cincinnatiarts.org/plan-your-visit/music-hall/directions-parking-1.

places.title: Washington Park, Cincinnati

source.title: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder — 1230 Elm Street, Public_AR_Current

places.precision: Approximate TIGER address-range point for the park's listed 1230 Elm Street address, not a park centroid or a particular gate. Cincinnati Arts identifies the Washington Park garage at this address across Elm Street from Music Hall: https://www.cincinnatiarts.org/plan-your-visit/music-hall/directions-parking-1.

places.title: Wright-Dunbar Interpretive Center

source.title: National Park Service event location at Wright-Dunbar Interpretive Center

places.precision: NPS-published event location coordinate for the Interpretive Center, a suitable site-level orientation point but not a surveyed building entrance. NPS visitor-center address and directions: https://www.nps.gov/daav/planyourvisit/directions.htm.

places.title: Paul Laurence Dunbar House Historic Site

source.title: National Park Service event location at Dunbar House

places.precision: NPS-published event location coordinate for the Dunbar House site, used as an orientation point rather than an entrance survey. NPS site address and directions: https://www.nps.gov/daav/planyourvisit/directions.htm.

places.title: Huffman Prairie Flying Field, Gate 16A access

source.title: National Park Service event location at Huffman Prairie Flying Field, Gate 16A

places.precision: NPS-published location for the Flying Field at Gate 16A, not the Huffman Prairie Flying Field Interpretive Center at 2380 Memorial Road. Do not use this point to route visitors to the visitor center; NPS directions distinguish the center and field access: https://www.nps.gov/daav/planyourvisit/directions.htm.

places.title: Glen Helen Cascades Lot

source.title: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder — 1075 OH-343, Public_AR_Current

places.precision: Approximate TIGER address-range coordinate for the Cascades Lot address listed by Glen Helen; it is not the trailhead or waterfall location. Confirm current lot status and directions with the preserve: https://glenhelen.org/directions-and-parking/.

places.title: Glen Helen Steps Lot

source.title: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder — 505 Corry Street, Public_AR_Current

places.precision: Approximate TIGER address-range coordinate for the Steps Lot address listed by Glen Helen; it is not a trailhead or a guarantee of parking availability. Confirm current directions with the preserve: https://glenhelen.org/directions-and-parking/.

places.title: Nelsonville Public Square

source.title: Ohio Department of Transportation, Appalachian Byway Corridor Management Plan

places.precision: ODOT plan coordinate identified for Nelsonville Public Square. It is a plan location point for the square, not an entrance or a parcel survey.

places.title: Hocking Valley Scenic Railway depot

source.title: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder — 33 W Canal Street, Public_AR_Current

places.precision: Approximate TIGER address-range coordinate for the railway's depot address, not a measured platform or boarding point. The operator's accessibility and boarding details should govern visit planning: https://www.hvsry.org/accessibility/.

places.title: CanalWay Center, Ohio & Erie Canal Reservation

source.title: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder — 4524 East 49th Street, Public_AR_Current

places.precision: Approximate TIGER address-range point for Cleveland Metroparks' CanalWay Center address. It identifies an orientation point in the Ohio & Erie Canal Reservation, not the historic Cleveland canal terminus, river mouth, or canal alignment. Address and location context: https://www.clevelandmetroparks.com/parks/visit/parks/ohio-erie-canal-reservation/canalway-center.

places.title: Cuyahoga River at Cleveland — USGS gaging station

source.title: U.S. Geological Survey, Cuyahoga River at Cleveland OH (04208500)

places.precision: USGS monitoring-station coordinate. This is a river measurement site, not the Cuyahoga mouth or a public shoreline access point.

places.title: Lake Erie at Cleveland — USGS monitoring location

source.title: U.S. Geological Survey, Lake Erie at Cleveland (412941081433600)

places.precision: USGS lake monitoring-site coordinate; metadata identifies this point as interpolated from a map with ±5 seconds stated accuracy. It is a sampling location, not a public beach, shore access, or water-intake location.

mappingNote: If the eventual map uses OpenStreetMap data or tiles, show the attribution required by the selected OSM service/provider. These coordinates do not supply a basemap or imply permission to reproduce third-party imagery.
